claims.claim: Hebrew NLP models used: the DictaBERT family (dicta-il/dictabert base masked-LM, -ner, -sentiment, -morph, -joint, -heq, -large-char-menaked Nakdan, neodictabert-bilingual-embed), the DictaLM 3.0 family (24B-Base/Thinking, Nemotron-12B-Instruct/Base, 1.7B-Thinking GGUF, FP8 and W4A16 quantized checkpoints), and ivrit.ai Whisper (whisper-large-v3, -turbo-ct2, faster-whisper-v2-d4). All IDs resolved via the HuggingFace models API on 2026-09-15. dictabert is a masked-LM base with no classification head
claims.raw_snippet: dicta-il (DICTA: The Israel Center for Text Analysis)
claims.verified_via: navigational claim; every model ID checked with https://huggingface.co/api/models/<id> returning HTTP 200 on 2026-09-15

claims.claim: The ivrit.ai Hebrew audio corpus is over 22,000 hours (22K+), as of July 2025
claims.raw_snippet: the world’s largest Hebrew audio dataset, over 22,000 hours

claims.claim: ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3 was trained on about 5,000 hours: Knesset plenums ~4700h, crowd-transcribe-v5 ~300h, crowd-recital ~50h; license apache-2.0
claims.raw_snippet: A subset of a Knesset (Israeli house of representatives) plenum protocols. ~4700h

claims.claim: ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3 has about 1.55B parameters (API safetensors total 1543490560) and the turbo variant about 809M (API total 808878080, shown on the model page as 0.8B)
ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2 is a CTranslate2 build loaded with faster_whisper.WhisperModel and transcribed with language='he'
faster-whisper segments is a generator; CPU uses compute_type int8; vad_filter=True and word_timestamps=True options exist
claims.raw_snippet: is a *generator* so the transcription only starts when you iterate over it

claims.claim: ivrit-ai/faster-whisper-v2-d4 is based on whisper-large-v2 and crowd-transcribe-v4, released September 2024
dicta-il/dictabert-ner has 13 entity types: ANG, DUC, EVE, FAC, GPE, INFORMAL, LOC, MISC, ORG, PER, TIMEX, TTL, WOA
dictabert-ner pipeline with aggregation_strategy='simple' needs a WordPiece decoder set on the tokenizer; DictaBERT models are licensed cc-by-4.0
dicta-il/dictabert-sentiment works directly with the sentiment-analysis pipeline, labels Positive / Negative / Neutral
dicta-il/dictabert-joint is loaded with trust_remote_code=True and exposes predict(sentences, tokenizer, output_style='json')

neodictabert-bilingual-embed is a sentence-transformers model loaded with trust_remote_code=True, using encode_query with a 'query: ' prefix and encode_document; 768-dimensional vectors; about 363M parameters (362588928)
claims.raw_snippet: maps sentences & paragraphs to a 768-dimensional dense vector space

claims.claim: neodictabert-bilingual-embed safetensors total is 362588928 parameters per the HF API (~363M), shown on the model page as 0.4B

DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B-Instruct is under the NVIDIA Open Model License, loads with trust_remote_code=True, and the card recommends vllm serve with --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes --trust-remote-code
DictaLM-3.0-24B-Base is licensed apache-2.0
dictabert-large-char-menaked targets modern Hebrew prose, not Biblical, Rabbinic, premodern or poetic texts; predict takes a list of sentences
claims.raw_snippet: it is not intended for earlier layers of Hebrew (e.g. Biblical, Rabbinic, Premodern), nor for poetic texts

claims.claim: Hebrew preprocessing: the U+0591-U+05C7 block holds points and cantillation plus punctuation; maqaf is U+05BE, paseq U+05C0, sof pasuq U+05C3, nun hafukha U+05C6; the regex strips U+0591-U+05BD, U+05BF, U+05C1-U+05C2, U+05C4-U+05C5, U+05C7

DictaLM 3.0 models were continuously pre-trained on about 100 billion (100B) Hebrew tokens mixed with 30B tokens of English data; the 1.7B model is built on Qwen3 1.7B, the 24B on Mistral-Small-3.1-24B, the 12B on NVIDIA Nemotron Nano v2 12B
claims.raw_snippet: All three models were continuously pre-trained on approximately 100 billion tokens of Hebrew, mixed together with 30B tokens of English data.

claims.claim: Weights-only memory estimate: BF16 stores 2 bytes per parameter, so 24B is about 48GB, 12B about 24GB, 1.7B about 3.5GB; FP8 about half, W4A16 about a quarter; KV cache and activations excluded
claims.verified_via: arithmetic from parameter counts (24B, 12B, 1.7B) at 16 bits per parameter; labelled in the skill as a weights-only estimate, not a vendor figure

claims.claim: ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2 lists 295 hours of crowd-transcribe-v5 speech plus 93 hours of professionally transcribed speech from other sources
claims.raw_snippet: Training data includes 295 hours of volunteer-transcribed speech from the ivrit-ai/crowd-transcribe-v5 dataset, as well as 93 hours of professional transcribed speech from other sources.

claims.claim: dicta-il/dictabert-morph is the model for morphological tagging
claims.raw_snippet: This is the fine-tuned model for the morphological tagging task.

claims.claim: dicta-il/dictabert-seg is the model for prefix segmentation
claims.raw_snippet: This is the fine-tuned model for the prefix segmentation task.
